allowed_hosts: git remotes of repositories checked by $GIT_CHECKER (default /usr/local/bin/git-checker.sh)

scripts.purpose: Runs on a server and produces a read-only Arch Linux maintenance report, then clears that server's pending maintenance marker. Settings come from USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG, the installed config, or the repository's remote/config template; arguments are ignored. install.sh deploys this script, remote/git-checker.sh, and remote/config to each host in REMOTE_SERVERS; no local orchestrator is involved.

environment.name: USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG
environment.description: Explicit config path; takes precedence over the installed config and remote/config. An unreadable explicit path is an error.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.description: Base directory for the installed config lookup.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Base for config-defined paths and the searched home directory.

environment.name: STATE_DIR
environment.description: Directory holding the maintenance countdown and pending marker.

environment.name: MAX_BACKUP_AGE_DAYS
environment.description: Age in days at which the newest backup counts as overdue.

environment.name: MIN_SNAPSHOTS
environment.description: Minimum number of Timeshift snapshots required.

environment.name: MAX_SNAPSHOT_AGE_DAYS
environment.description: Age in days at which the newest snapshot counts as too old.

environment.name: GIT_CHECKER
environment.description: Executable used for the Git repository check.

network_hosts: git remotes of repositories checked by $GIT_CHECKER

exit_codes.meaning: The report completed; individual checks may print warnings or errors without changing the exit status.
Run as root, pacman missing, or config file unreadable.
